description: This file contains functions and commands related to NAND flash memory management and firmware upgrade procedures, specifically for embedded devices running OpenWrt. It includes logic for identifying firmware image types, mounting and managing UBI volumes, creating and removing volumes, and handling different firmware update workflows.

methods.name: nand_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a given directory representing a device in /dev.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds the UBI volume associated with a given UBI device and name.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device name given a partition.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of a NAND image based on its magic number.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the type of a tar-contained image.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if the file is gzip compressed and returns a marker.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from a backup file to the NAND file system.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a UBI block device.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI partition to create a UBI device.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI device from a partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for a firmware upgrade, creating kernel, rootfs, and data volumes.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Flashes a ubinized firmware image to the UBI partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Flashes a UBIFS image onto the UBI root volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Updates the UBI kernel volume with a FIT image.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Upgrades NAND from a tar archive containing multiple files.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a gzip compressed file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Identifies and flashes a firmware file based on its type.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration after firmware upgrade.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform firmware upgrade from a given file or pipe.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Performs tasks after successful upgrade, including reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles cleanup after failed upgrade and triggers reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if a firmware file is compatible with the platform.
